name: Direct app launch opens login
description: Verifies the app manifest entry opens the KHUSHI HOMES login screen instead of the public website landing page.
expected: The KHUSHI HOMES email/password login screen is shown directly and the public landing page is not shown.

name: New member can sign in with email and password
description: Verifies a new member entering a valid email and password can be created and signed in from the login screen.
steps: Enter a new valid email address and a password of at least 6 characters
expected: A new account is created automatically and the member is taken into the KHUSHI HOMES app without an incorrect-password error.

name: Existing member can recover a wrong password
description: Verifies an existing account with a wrong password receives a clear recovery message and can use password reset.
steps: Enter an existing account email with an incorrect password
Observe the message and use Forgot password
expected: The app explains that the password is incorrect for an existing account and provides the Forgot password action.

name: Existing app controls remain available after sign-in
description: Verifies the existing authenticated KHUSHI HOMES experience remains accessible after the authentication changes.
steps: Sign in with a valid member account
expected: Devices, subscription options, and Settings remain accessible after sign-in.
